title: Wireless
author: Charles Stross
note: conf=0.95; Verified: ISBN 9780441017195 = Wireless by Charles Stross, Ace Books, July 2009 (US 1st ed.). It is a standalone single-author short-story collection (contents: Missile Gap, Rogue Farm, A Colder War, MAXOS, Down on the Farm, Unwirer with Cory Doctorow, Snowball's Chance, Trunk and Disorderly, Palimpsest). UK Orbit edition adds the subtitle "The Essential Charles Stross" — a subtitle, not a series. Although one story ("Down on the Farm") belongs to the Laundry Files universe, the book itself is not part of that or any numbered series, so series = null. Proposed identification confirmed unchanged.
